chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Fadalah and Muhammad ibn Abi 'Umayr, from Mu'awiyah ibn 'Ammar, who said:
I asked Aba 'Abdillah عليه السلام about a man who fiddles with his private part during the obligatory salat (prayer). He said: “There is no harm in it.”

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ بِهِ: there is no harm in it; it is not problematic

ai.seo_question: Does touching one's private part during obligatory salat (prayer) invalidate the prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a man touching or handling his private part during the obligatory salat (prayer). Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that there is no harm in it, indicating that this act does not itself invalidate the prayer.
